---
name: Source-led production packet
about: Propose an original visual, film, cartoon, history lesson, or book experience
title: "[Production Packet] "
labels: ["research", "requires-owner-release"]
---

## Identity

Provide the working title, version, creator credit, and intended audience or use.

## Source lane

Identify the owner-authored record, original work, public archive, scholarly collection, or other source that informed the concept. Include a public URL or stable citation when one exists.

## Original production concept

Describe the new original narrative, characters, visual language, and intended format. Do not submit another creator’s protected footage, music, visual work, characters, or likenesses.

## Accessibility and youth safety

Describe captions, transcript, alt text, audio description, flash/sound sensitivity review, and adult-supported participation guidance when youth-facing.

## Rights and release state

Mark the proposal as **Research** or **Requires owner release**. State any rights, contributor, destination, or creator-release material still needed.

## Correction path

Provide a public correction contact or route for source, credit, or version updates.

> Do not include credentials, wallet material, private legal/identity records, personal contact details, unreleased masters, or private family documents in this public issue.
